wth.text: Mirri is a cat warrior, banished from her forest for having two different eye colors, who becomes a student of Multani and befriends Gerrard and Rofellos, falling in love with Gerrard.

She walks the Spirit Path, defeats her spirit beast and chooses Gerrard, receiving a prophecy that her path will lead Gerrard to his death, and then she joins the Weatherlight crew with Rofellos and Gerrard to find the Legacy artifacts.
After Rofellos is killed, Gerrard leaves the ship and Mirri goes with him, and three years later Gerrard asks Mirri to be his Lieutenant and she rejoins the crew to rescue Captain Sisay.

On Rath she is gravely wounded diving in front of Crovax to deflect Selenia's strike, and when she sees Crovax sabotaging the sails she attacks him and both tumble overboard, where she lets Crovax kill her so that Gerrard will save himself, fulfilling the prophecy.

sth.text: In the Stronghold Mirri is startled by Volrath's scentless apparition, then leaps silently and a guard dies.
Crovax strikes down Selenia, who shatters into shards that warp him into a vampire, and he kills Mirri after she follows him on deck and they fall into Volrath's garden.

exo.text: Selenia hurt Mirri badly and tore wounds in Crovax's soul that will not close, yet despite her exhaustion Mirri follows Crovax's skulking form.
